usedFor: Trafft holds appointments and customers, and Freshsales Classic receives changes to deals through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Appointment Booked” in Trafft, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A booking is a clear step forward in a deal, and the action updates it.

watchOut: “Appointment Status Changed” and “Appointment Rescheduled” in Trafft both fire, so one appointment can update the deal repeatedly.
